title: glTF positions loaded with Y negated (a mirror, not an up-axis change), compensated by clockwise front faces and a -90 degree rotation
expected_finding: loadModel writes vertex.pos = (x, -y, z) from the glTF POSITION accessor, a reflection (determinant -1) of the right-handed, CCW-wound glTF mesh, so the object-space input of vertMain is mirrored; the pipeline's frontFace = CLOCKWISE only compensates the winding flip the reflection causes, and the model renders as its mirror image
